newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - GE rating reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GE rating reiterated.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said on Friday it had reiterated its rating of aggressive buy for General Electric Co.

-- Analyst Michael Linsky said in a report he expected that around Dec 20 GE would increase its quarterly cash dividend by a double-digit amount. The increase would take effect with GE's first-quarter 1997 dividend.
-- "Our belief is that the single most likely boost is to $0.52 per share quarterly, up 13 percent from the current rate of $0.46 per share quarterly," he wrote.
-- Linsky said he expected GE also to extend its share buyback program, with $3.2 billion in repurchases in 1996 and at least that amount of buybacks next year.
-- He also expected the company would announce a stock split shortly, "quite possibly a two-for-one split."
